title: main: client MUST supply ULID for senderReactionId
description: Message/set says 'the client MUST supply a ULID as the senderReactionId'. Any opaque unique string satisfies the protocol requirements (deduplication, idempotency). ULID is a best practice for lexicographic ordering but is not required for correctness. Decision: change to SHOULD, or keep MUST and justify why ULID specifically is required (e.g., if the server relies on ULID ordering for reaction display).
close_reason: Downgraded MUST to SHOULD — any opaque client-assigned unique string satisfies the protocol requirements; ULID is best practice for consistency with other IDs but not a correctness requirement.
